### A Joyful Heart
Author: Alistair Begg
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/truth-for-life/truth-for-life-september-6-2023.html
Passage: 1 Samuel 2:1
Points:
- Hannah connected God's personal goodness to her with His broader covenant deliverance.
- Biblical worship engages the entire heart, including the mind, affections, and will.
- Hannah's thanksgiving echoes Miriam’s praise and anticipates Mary’s Magnificat.
- Believers are called to avoid passive or overly reserved routines when praising the living God.

### There Is No Rock Like God
Author: Whitney Hopler
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/crosswalk-devo/there-is-no-rock-like-god-the-crosswalk-devotional.html
Passage: 1 Samuel 2:2
Points:
- God's unique holiness and perfection serve as the foundation of His trustworthiness.
- Describing God as a rock emphasizes His unchanging resilience and stability in an unstable world.
- Because God is all-powerful, all-knowing, and always present, He can handle every burden.
- Relying on God as a firm foundation encourages believers to let go of anxiety.
